a `textDelta` carries the `seq` of the event it will become part of and is never persisted.

decision.description: Absent when withdrawn (cancelled, or the asking connection went away).

oneOf.description:
The download is the file itself (a single executable, e.g. `rustup-init`), placed at
the root under its URL's last path segment, executable. Added in M2-ENV-003.

URL's last segment without `.gz` (or the artifact's `file_name`), executable. M5.5.

Two reads return equal versions iff the bytes are equal.

chain.description: `chain[0]` is the hit node; the rest are its ancestors up to the root.

authToken.description:

protocolVersion.description:
Version the daemon will speak on this connection: same MAJOR as the

WorkspaceId.description: Opaque identifier of an open workspace, minted by `workspace/open`.

WorkspacePath.description:
A path inside a workspace: relative to the workspace root, `/`-separated,
UTF-8, with no `.`/`..` segments, no leading `/`, and no trailing `/`.
The workspace root itself is the empty string.

Clients never send absolute host paths except in `workspace/open`. The
daemon rejects any `WorkspacePath` that fails these rules with
[`ErrorKind::InvalidParams`] and any that resolves (through symlinks)
outside the root with [`ErrorKind::PermissionDenied`].

expectedVersion.description:
Version the client last read. If set, the write is refused with
`conflict` unless the file on disk still has this version. Omit to
create a new file (fails with `conflict` if the file exists) —
set [`WriteFileParams::overwrite`] to bypass both checks.

overwrite.description: Write unconditionally. Used for "overwrite anyway" after a conflict.
